title: New staff ping & emergency guidelines
summary: New guidelines clarify when staff should be pinged and introduce an emergency role for urgent situations.
description: The support process was updated to reduce unnecessary staff pings while still giving members a way to flag genuinely urgent problems.

body.text: Members should contact helpers first and avoid repeatedly pinging staff. Moderators should generally only be contacted when helpers have not responded after several hours.
A dedicated emergency ping was introduced for urgent cases, with misuse subject to moderation action.
